name: What kind of prep work is done before painting a new addition?

mainEntity.name: What kind of prep work is done before painting a new addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Extensive preparation is crucial before painting a new addition to ensure a smooth and lasting finish. This typically includes cleaning all surfaces to remove dust and debris, patching any imperfections or nail holes, sanding walls and trim to create a uniform surface, and applying primer. Priming helps to seal the new surfaces, promotes better paint adhesion, and ensures a more even and vibrant color. Proper preparation prevents issues like peeling or uneven finishes down the line.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prep work includes cleaning, patching, sanding, and priming all surfaces to ensure a smooth, lasting finish.
